subject: PH onboarding: BIR registration, e-invoice XML sample & PO VAT fields
messages:
From: Mariposa Dela Cruz <m.delacruz@mabuhaytech.ph>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12 13:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PH onboarding docs – COR + sample invoice

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding packet. Attached are our Certificate of Registration (COR) and our VAT/TIN certificate requested by finance. I also attached a sample invoice in XML (our current e-invoice export) so you can confirm format compatibility with Redwood's PO system.

A couple of notes that might help your team:
- Our VAT number (TIN) is on the COR PDF header.
- Our invoices currently include a separate line for VAT (12%) and reference the PO number if provided.
- We can produce the invoice in the simplified XML schema or a flat CSV if your ingestion requires it.

Let me know if you need a stamped BIR certificate or a bank letter for beneficiary verification. We can provide both.

Best,
Mariposa Dela Cruz
Head of Finance Operations
Mabuhay Tech, Inc.
Attachments: Mabuhay_COR_2026.pdf (certificate), Mabuhay_TIN_VAT_Certificate.pdf (VAT certificate), sample_invoice_2026.xml (invoice XML)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Mariposa Dela Cruz <m.delacruz@mabuhaytech.ph>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PH onboarding docs – BIR docs + PO VAT mapping

Hi Mariposa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending the XML sample. A couple quick asks from our side to get PO generation and payment routing moving: 

1) Can you confirm the exact legal entity name that should appear on the Redwood PO (for our AP accounting and vendor master)?
2) We need a scanned bank verification letter or a voided cheque for wire setup (Finance).
3) For e-invoice compatibility, could you attach a brief schema map showing which XML tags contain: invoice number, VAT line amount, and line-level commodity description? If you don't have a map, a 2–3 line sample mapping from the XML will be enough.
4) Redwood requires a listed VAT breakdown per PO line (we show subtotal, VAT, and total). Will your invoice always include per-line VAT or only a single VAT summary line?

Ben (cc'd) — any additional requirements from AP?

Thanks — once we have those items we can issue a PO and send the initial test invoice through our ingest path.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Mariposa Dela Cruz <m.delacruz@mabuhaytech.ph>
Date: 2026-08-12 19:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PH onboarding docs – BIR docs + PO VAT mapping

Marissa / Mariposa —

Couple of items from Finance / AP to speed payment and correct tax handling: 

- Legal entity on PO should match the COR: "Mabuhay Tech, Inc." exactly (no DBAs).
- We need a bank verification doc (bank letter) with beneficiary name and SWIFT/IBAN equivalent for international wires. Local Philippines wires can use BDO/MetroBank details if that is easier.
- Withholding tax: Redwood classifies service invoices from PH suppliers for contractor services under the local withholding schedule. We'll apply the appropriate withholding per our tax table (we typically withhold 2% or 5% depending on nature of services). Please confirm whether Mabuhay is VAT-registered (you provided certificate) and whether you expect Redwood to gross up payments or apply withholding net of VAT.
- For PO ingestion: send one sample invoice where the invoice XML includes a PO number in the <OrderReference> (or similar) element. If the XML lacks a PO reference, Finance will require that the vendor paste the Redwood PO number in the invoice notes and in the payment instruction block.

Kimberly — can you confirm if Finance needs a localized tax residency attestation for the Philippines (certificate from tax authority) in addition to the COR?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Mariposa Dela Cruz <m.delacruz@mabuhaytech.ph>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13 02:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PH onboarding docs – BIR docs + PO VAT mapping

Hi Ben / Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks — confirming the items below: 
- Legal name for PO = Mabuhay Tech, Inc. (matches COR).
- Bank letter: attaching a scanned bank confirmation and our beneficiary routing sheet. (ATTACH: bank_verification_mabuhay.pdf)
- VAT: we are VAT-registered and VAT is shown per-line in our XML export. The sample_invoice_2026.xml includes a <TaxSummary> and per-line <TaxAmount> elements. I added a short mapping in-line at the top of the XML file for your engineers.
- Withholding: for local services we are typically subject to 2% withholding; for certain subcontractor arrangements it may be 5%. The invoice will show gross amounts, Redwood should apply withholding on the taxable base. We do not expect gross-up.

I can produce a BIR-stamped residency attestation if required — it typically takes 3–5 business days from our tax agent. Please confirm if Redwood needs that before we receive a PO or if it can be provided post-PO for finance records.

Regards,
Mariposa

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Mariposa Dela Cruz <m.delacruz@mabuhaytech.ph>
Date: 2026-08-13 11:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PH onboarding docs – BIR docs + PO VAT mapping

Marissa / Ben —

Finance confirmed the following: 
- We can issue the initial PO using the COR-backed legal name; our vendor master will note the VAT/TIN.
- Bank verification document is sufficient for wire setup; local currency vs USD settlement will be discussed in the invoice stub.
- The BIR residency attestation is optional at PO creation; please obtain it within 7 business days for our audit folder.
- Please ensure the sample XML includes explicit tags for invoice_total, invoice_tax, and order_reference. If the tags differ, provide a 1-page field map.
- I'll attach the PO template we use for non-US suppliers so the vendor can see required fields (attached: PO_TEMPLATE_REDWOOD.pdf).

Once Mariposa confirms the mapping and we receive the bank letter, we'll create the vendor record and issue the PO (internal target: within 48 hours).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Mariposa Dela Cruz <m.delacruz@mabuhaytech.ph>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-14 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PH onboarding docs – BIR docs + PO VAT mapping

All —

Acknowledged. I attached a short 1-page field map at the top of sample_invoice_2026.xml and the bank_verification_mabuhay.pdf. We will produce the BIR residency attestation and send within 3 business days as requested.

Please confirm the PO number format so we can include it in future invoices (example provided by Redwood would be helpful).

Looking forward to the test invoice.

Best regards,
Mariposa Dela Cruz
Head of Finance Operations
Mabuhay Tech, Inc.
Attachments: bank_verification_mabuhay.pdf, updated_sample_invoice_2026.xml (field map appended)
